adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `parseRefreshTokenResponse()` which, when `refresh_token` is absent, sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:24-27). In Office365 calendar refresh, the returned object is spread into `o365AuthCredentials` (`{ ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`), so if Microsoft’s refresh response omits `refresh_token`, the placeholder value overwrites the previously valid `o365AuthCredentials.refresh_token` before persisting via `prisma.credential.update` (packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts). This can silently corrupt the stored refresh token and force re-auth.
